title: iOS 27 Bank SMS Setup Video | TrackExpenses
description: Watch the iOS 27 Shortcuts setup for bank SMS expense imports, with real screens, chapter links and a full transcript.
name: Set up bank SMS imports on iOS 27

chapters.title: Start in the Library
chapters.text: Open Shortcuts. Go back to Library, then choose Automation.

chapters.title: Create a new shortcut
chapters.text: Tap the + at the bottom. In iOS 27, automations live inside shortcuts.

chapters.title: Open the editor
chapters.text: If Describe a Shortcut opens, tap Editor or Edit. Then tap Automation in the actions panel.

chapters.title: Choose Message
chapters.text: Under Communication, tap Message to add the incoming-message trigger.

chapters.title: Change the filter field
chapters.text: Tap the first blue Sender field. This chooses what part of the message to match.

chapters.title: Match the message text
chapters.text: Choose Message from the menu. The condition becomes Message contains Text.

chapters.title: Use your bank’s wording
chapters.text: Tap Text and enter wording from your bank alerts. Purchase is only an example. Then tap the trigger’s blue arrow.

chapters.title: Let it run automatically
chapters.text: Keep Automation on and Confirm Before Run off. These replace the older Run Immediately screen.

chapters.title: Find the import action
chapters.text: Tap Search, type Import Bank Message, then select the TrackExpenses action.

chapters.title: Connect the incoming text
chapters.text: Tap the blue Message placeholder inside Import transaction from Message.

chapters.title: Open Select Variable
chapters.text: Tap Select Variable in the bottom bar. Do not type a message or use Ask Each Time.

chapters.title: Choose the trigger’s Message
chapters.text: Tap Message directly below the trigger. In iOS 27 this is the incoming message output.

chapters.title: Use the message body
chapters.text: Close the bottom bar with ×. Tap the inserted Message variable to see its properties.

chapters.title: Choose Content
chapters.text: In the variable’s Get list, choose Content. Tap Return, then close the variable bar with ×.

chapters.title: Keep imports quiet
chapters.text: Expand the import action’s blue arrow and turn Show When Run off. The connected variable should say Content.

chapters.title: Check the shortcut’s privacy
chapters.text: Tap the ⓘ button in the editor toolbar, then open Privacy.

chapters.title: Allow it while locked
chapters.text: Keep Allow Running When Locked enabled. Go back to Details, tap Done, then back to save the shortcut.

chapters.title: Ready for your next bank alert
chapters.text: Confirm the automation is enabled. Check the next matching alert in TrackExpenses → More → SMS Auto-Import.

title: iOS 26 Bank SMS Setup Video | TrackExpenses
description: Watch the iOS 26 Shortcuts setup for bank SMS expense imports, with real screens, chapter links and a full transcript.
name: Set up bank SMS imports on iOS 26

chapters.title: Create a Message automation
chapters.text: In Shortcuts, open Automation. Tap +, then choose Message.

chapters.title: Match your bank's wording
chapters.text: We use “purchase” as an example. Enter a phrase or currency code that appears in YOUR bank alerts.

chapters.title: Run automatically
chapters.text: Leave Sender as Any Sender. Choose Run Immediately, then tap Next.

chapters.title: Create a blank shortcut
chapters.text: Tap Create New Shortcut under Get Started.

chapters.title: Add the bank import action
chapters.text: Search for Import Bank Message. Tap the TrackExpenses action.

chapters.title: Tap the Message field
chapters.text: Tap the blue Message placeholder inside the import action. A variable bar opens at the bottom.

chapters.title: Tap Select Variable
chapters.text: At the bottom, tap Select Variable. If the keyboard is open, look just above it.

chapters.title: Choose Shortcut Input
chapters.text: Tap the blue Shortcut Input beneath “Receive messages as input”. This passes the incoming SMS to the action.

chapters.title: Check the connection
chapters.text: The action now says Shortcut Input. Do not type those words yourself. Tap × to close the variable bar.

chapters.title: Keep imports quiet
chapters.text: Tap the arrow beside the action. Turn Show When Run off.

chapters.title: Save your automation
chapters.text: Tap the blue checkmark. Matching bank alerts will now reach TrackExpenses.
